gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Width and height of 7 degrees each should resolve to geohash precision level 3.
ADDED i3: A very large longitude error with zero latitude error should fall back to maximum precision (24).
ADDED i4: A 12-character geohash should produce exactly 32 sub-geohashes (one per BASE-32 character).
ADDED i5: Decoding geohash "dQ;Z" should yield roughly lon=-74.707, lat=37.881 in the GEO context.
ADDED i6: Hash length 116 exceeds the internal lookup-table bounds and must throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
ADDED i9: Encoding lat=3.1414..., lon=3.1414... at default precision should produce "s0d1z7z7zzzz".
